title: Crohamhurst Observatory

terrainReference.basis: Fixed outside northern frontage point selected from native rectangle before independent terrain/geometry; not surveyed finished-floor datum.

mapIdentity.scope: Actual front333.265m² rectangular roof; observatory identity supported by relative front location/shape/1935 reference and official description, rather than named provider label. Southwest shed/instrument positions estimated; separate eastern/southern roofs excluded.

note: Whole surviving1935 timber observatory: actual front rectangular roof extent, low timber stumps, weatherboard body and currently enclosed north/east casement verandas, hipped fibre-cement roof with north/east/west louvred gablets and entry gable, attached southwest shed, and intrinsic Stevenson screen, low temperature-pit caps, remnant instrument strip and sundial/telescope-marker stands. Separate later residence/eastern house/workshop, trees/private garden/fences/cars/people excluded. Before geometry, level observatory/shed floor fixed0.65m above independent north-east/uphill corner sample[9.617638455228631,-6.878404663590821]. Low stumps at that corner, with longer exposed toes on the downhill west; original opening photo also shows falling ground and exposed posts. Support toes alone consume the unchanged field. Native QRA automated slab/floor/class labels are not a floor survey and are not fitted to the independent Terrarium datum. Coarse source DEM may include vegetation/building effects; exact stumps/steps/grade contact unverified, geographic preview approximate and replacement disabled. No terrain flattening/fitting/reacquisition.
